verdict.rationale: Glama ships its own chat assistant at glama.ai/chat. It gives access to leading models, answers questions about uploaded documents with page references, and turns text descriptions into diagrams, so users can hand some tasks to a built-in AI. A pricing-page line also mentions automating workflows with schedules or webhooks, but it is not tied to the assistant. There is no evidence that the assistant can take agentic actions inside Glama itself, such as deploying, configuring or testing MCP servers. Missing for 10: documented agentic task delegation where the assistant acts on Glama resources, detail on how assistant-driven automations work, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Access every leading model with a single account. Same familiar UI, powerful features, no limits.
Upload any PDF, Word doc, or text file. Get instant answers with exact page references.
Transform text descriptions into professional diagrams.
Automate workflows using schedules or webhooks.
